target_roi_validity_values.usable: Target-species flower is clearly present and the crop is sufficiently flower-dominant for direct colour-feature use.
target_roi_validity_values.rescue_segment: Target-species flower is clearly present and condition can be judged, but the crop is too broad/background-dominant for direct colour-feature use; retain for a later mask/refined-crop rescue.
target_roi_validity_values.invalid: No evaluable target-species flower is present, or the crop is clearly non-target/non-floral.
target_roi_validity_values.ambiguous: Target identity or crop suitability cannot be judged confidently from the blinded sheet.

rules: ROI validity is judged before flower condition.
Colour candidate scores, geography, observer and date must not be used during review.
No colour-state label is assigned during this review.
A rescue_segment crop is retained rather than excluded and is sent to segmentation/refined-crop recovery.
Condition is not_evaluable when no target flower can be judged.
No numeric area threshold is estimated from the current 480 images.
downstream_use: Only usable fresh records may enter the first direct-colour-rule recalibration. rescue_segment records require independent crop/mask recovery first. invalid and ambiguous records cannot define colour rules.
